[In partnership with Dolby] What does Dolby Atmos actually change when you experience music inside a car?
Mahindra and Dolby have worked together to bring Dolby Atmos to cars including the XUV 3XO RevX, Thar Roxx and XEV 9e, bringing three-dimensional audio to a wider range of vehicles.
In this film, we look at how Dolby Atmos works, why it isn't simply about adding more speakers, and how Mahindra and Dolby tune the system around each car's acoustic characteristics.
